CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 3

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

4. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 40.5
   C. 10
   D. 9

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 12

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

11. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 64

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 30

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

17. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

19. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
